entities.name: 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Primary authentication procedure using 5G AKA method for establishing security context between UE and network.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE containing authentication challenge parameters.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network containing authentication response parameters.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network indicating authentication failure with specific 5GMM cause.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE to terminate authentication procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3560
entities.description: Network timer for AUTHENTICATION REQUEST retransmission, expires after 4 retransmissions.

entities.name: Timer T3520
entities.description: UE timer started upon sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message, guards authentication failure handling.

entities.name: MAC failure condition
entities.description: Condition where UE detects MAC validation failure in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: Synchronization failure condition
entities.description: Condition where UE detects sequence number synchronization failure in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.

entities.name: Non-5G authentication unacceptable condition
entities.description: Condition where UE rejects non-5G authentication method in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.

entities.name: ngKSI already in use condition
entities.description: Condition where UE detects ngKSI parameter conflict in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.

entities.name: Procedure abortion
entities.description: Network behavior to abort authentication procedure upon timer expiry or lower layer failure.

entities.name: Procedure re-initiation
entities.description: Network behavior to re-initiate authentication procedure after receiving specific failure causes.

relations.description: Authentication procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
Authentication procedure includes receiving AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.
Network starts timer T3560 when sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.
Network resets and starts timer T3560 upon retransmission of AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.
UE starts timer T3520 when sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
MAC failure condition triggers sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #20.
Synchronization failure condition triggers sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #21.
Non-5G authentication condition triggers sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #26.
ngKSI conflict condition triggers sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #71.
Fifth expiry of timer T3560 establishes procedure abortion by network.
Receipt of AUTHENTICATION REJECT message establishes procedure termination.
Synchronization failure condition establishes procedure re-initiation by network.
Receipt of new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST stops timer T3520 if running.
Receipt of AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE stops timer T3560.
